h1: Seagrove Beach "Above and Beyond" 50 Hinton-Bishop Drive
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Newly constructed home- Steps from the beach- Private pool *Pool heating is available from October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee of $100 per day.- Low-Speed Vehicle- Complimentary beach setups each morning include 2 beach chairs with 1 umbrella (Mar 1-Oct 31)- 10 adult bikes- Peloton bike- Pool Table- Carriage house- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered at every checkoutDETAILS: Experience unparalleled luxury at 50 Hinton-Bishop Drive with complimentary beach chair service for 2 every morning, situated in the coveted Seagrove Beach community. This exquisite 10-bedroom, 10.5-bathroom Main House—plus Carriage House—accommodates 28 guests along the stunning Emerald Coast, only 1 minute from the beach. Revel in the private saltwater pool and spa, savor late-night cocktails on the rooftop deck, and unwind with stunning views from balconies on every floor.An inviting entryway opens to the first-floor living area of this 4-story retreat, with plush furniture, a 65” TV, and wet bar. Accommodations include a bunk room with 2 queen-over-queen beds and private bathroom, 2 guest bedrooms with king beds, one boasting deck access and a private bathroom. A Peloton in the laundry room with 2 washer and dryers provides convenience. An expansive, partially-covered patio boasts a private pool and sitting spa and outdoor kitchen.Stairs, or the in-home elevator, lead up to the second floor and heart of this home. After a day on the water, gather with loved ones in the primary living area for an immersive movie night on the 65” TV with surround sound. A traditional dining table and breakfast bar, each seating 10, extends into the sleek white kitchen with 2 Wolf ovens for preparing large meals. Host an alfresco luncheon for 8 with the natural gas grill on the second-floor balcony. Rest easy in the 2 guest bedrooms, each with a king bed, private bathroom, and shared balcony.Enjoy the third-floor living area with a 65” TV, table for 4, and wet bar. Accommodations include 2 guest bedrooms with king beds and a shared balcony, a family-friendly bedroom with a king bed and twin-over-twin bunk, and 2 full-over-full beds in the bunk room—all with private bathrooms. There’s a washer and dryer in the hallway.The rooftop deck beckons guests to unwind on opulent outdoor furniture, sip cocktails at the wet bar, sunbathe on loungers, and unwind in front of the outdoor TV—an entertainer’s delight!Stairs lead to the Carriage House, featuring a kitchenette, cozy king bed, private bathroom, wet bar, and balcony.50 Hinton-Bishop Drive is the perfect family or group getaway! With on-site parking for 9 vehicles—plus 10 adult bikes and a 6-passenger low speed vehicle—exploring is a breeze. For beach access, take a 1-minute walk along the boardwalk at 49 Hinton-Bishop Drive or drive 3 minutes to Santa Clara Beach Access. body_text_excerpt: Destination Travel Collections Experiences + Services About Us Homeowners Travel Blog View Gallery Watch Video Seagrove Beach "Above and Beyond" 50 Hinton-Bishop Drive Santa Rosa Beach, FL Short Term Rental #STR-119588 Bedrooms 10 Beds 16 Sleeps 28 Full Baths 10 Half Baths 1 HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Newly constructed home - Steps from the beach - Private pool *Pool heating is available from October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee of $100 per day. - Low-Speed Vehicle - Complimentary beach setups each morning include 2 beach chairs with 1 umbrella (Mar 1-Oct 31) - 10 adult bikes - Peloton bike - Pool Table - Carriage house - Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered at every checkout DETAILS: Experience unparalleled luxury at 50 Hinton-Bishop Drive with complimentary beach chair service for 2 every morning, situated in the coveted Seagrove Beach community. This exquisite 10-bedroom, 10.5-bathroom Main House—plus Carriage House—accommodates 28 guests along the stunning Emerald Coast, only 1 minute from the beach. Revel in the private saltwater pool and spa, savor late-night cocktails on the rooftop deck, and unwind with stunning views from balconies on every floor. An inviting entryway opens to the first-floor living area of this 4-story retreat, with plush furniture, a 65” TV, and wet bar. Accommodations include a bunk room with 2 queen-over-queen beds and private bathroom, 2 guest bedrooms with king beds, one boasting deck access and a private bathroom. A Peloton in the laundry room with 2 washer and dryers provides convenience. An expansive, partially-covered patio boasts a private pool and sitting spa and outdoor kitchen. Stairs, or the in-home elevator, lead up to the second floor and heart of this home. After a day on the water, gather with loved ones in the primary living area for an immersive movie night on the 65” TV with surround sound. A traditional dining table and breakfast bar, each seating 10, extends into the sleek white kitchen with 2 Wolf ovens for preparing large meals. Host an alfresco luncheon for 8 with the natural gas grill on the second-floor balcony. Rest easy in the 2 guest bedrooms, each with a king bed, private bathroom, and shared balcony. Enjoy the third-floor living area with a 65” TV, table for 4, and wet bar. Accommodations include 2 guest bedrooms with king beds and a shared balcony, a family-friendly bedroom with a king bed and twin-over-twin bunk, and 2 full-over-full beds in the bunk room—all with private bathrooms. There’s a washer and dryer in the hallway. The rooftop deck beckons guests to unwind on opulent outdoor furniture, sip cocktails at the wet bar, sunbathe on loungers, and unwind in front of the outdoor TV—an entertainer’s delight! Stairs lead to the Carriage House, featuring a kitchenette, cozy king bed, private bathroom, wet bar, and balcony. 50 Hinton-Bishop Drive is the perfect family or group getaway! With on-site parking for 9 vehicles—plus 10 adult bikes and a 6-passenger low speed vehicle—exploring is a breeze. For beach access, take a 1-minute walk along the boardwalk at 49 Hinton-Bishop Drive or drive 3 minutes to Santa Clara Beach Access. Book today!
